entries.alt: John the Baptist listens to two men beside a river, one speaking with open hands.
entries.caption: People bring John a practical question about how to live. His answers turn repentance toward sharing, honesty and the fair treatment of others.
entries.findings: John matches actual supplied reference in facial profile, younger adult age, short beard and camel-hair clothing; reciprocal gaze and anatomy pass. Two foreground questioners at right share very similar curly hair, dark beard, facial shape, age and clothing. This repeats the user-rejected clone pattern.
conditions: Change only rear-right questioner to a distinctly older adult with broad face, receding gray hair, shorter gray beard and different nose/brow. Preserve John, foreground questioner, hands, river and composition. No literal Christ.
Technical acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.

entries.alt: Levi looks up from a customs counter toward Jesus, who faces him with an open hand.
entries.caption: Jesus meets Levi at his work and calls him to follow. Levi looks toward Him, his attention turning from the counter to the invitation.
entries.findings: Direct actual Christ-reference comparison: recognizable brow, eyes, nose, beard and wavy hair maintained in three-quarter profile. Warm restrained expression and direct mutual eye contact fit invitation. Hands, coin stacks and counter coherent. Levi remains largely seated; rising cannot be established from cropped lower body. Caption/title now describe the supported call rather than claiming a visible completed rise.
conditions: Use recommended title Jesus calls Levi, not Levi rises. Do not claim this frame depicts standing or leaving. Any counter implement is illustrative; no authenticated precise device claim. No Resurrection scars.
Technical acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.

entries.recommendedTitle: The news travels through the night
entries.alt: A messenger speaks to a woman and an older man in a doorway while another traveler handles a cloth bundle behind him.
entries.caption: News of the Savior's visit reaches a household in the night. Attentive faces receive the message as others prepare to gather the next day.
entries.findings: Repaired doorway man has gray short curls, lined broader face and no beard, distinctly different from messenger. Modern backpack removed, replaced by plain tied cloth bundle. Photographic firelight/moonlight, direct eye contact and coherent hands. Messenger lively urgent joy fits source.
conditions: Unnamed illustrative messenger/household, no exact words or named kinship assigned. Preserve original rejected image and its prior review. No claim of exact ancient American architecture or garment tradition.
Technical acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.
